```{r}
# Memuat library yang dibutuhkan
library(readxl)
library(urca)
library(forecast)
library(lmtest)
library(nortsTest)
library(rugarch)

# 1. PERSIAPAN DATA & PLOT RETURN
RMKO <- read_excel("D:/POLSTAT STIS/TINGKAT II/Sem 4/ARW/Data Historis RMKO.xlsx")
rmko = data.frame(RMKO)

rmko$Tanggal <- as.Date(rmko$Tanggal) 
rmko <- rmko[order(rmko$Tanggal), ]

# Mengambil kolom harga dan menghitung return
harga = rmko$Terakhir
ret = diff(log(harga)) * 100
ret = na.omit(ret)

# VISUAL 1: Plot Return Harian (Untuk melihat Volatility Clustering)
plot(ret, type="l", col="black", 
     main="Return Harian Saham RMKO (Volatility Clustering)", 
     ylab="Return (%)", xlab="Waktu")
abline(h=0, col="red", lty=2)

# 2. UJI STASIONERITAS & PEMILIHAN MODEL ARIMA
adf_ret = ur.df(ret, type="none", lags=2)
print(summary(adf_ret))

best_model = auto.arima(ret, trace=TRUE)
print(best_model)

# Ekstrak orde untuk mean.model GARCH
p_order = arimaorder(best_model)[1]
q_order = arimaorder(best_model)[3]
res_ret = resid(best_model)

# 3. UJI EFEK ARCH
uji_arch = arch.test(res_ret)
print(uji_arch)
p_value_arch = uji_arch$p.value

# 4. PEMODELAN GARCH & VISUALISASI
if (p_value_arch < 0.05) {
  # --- Estimasi Model (Menggunakan orde p dan q dinamis) ---
  spec.arch1 = ugarchspec(variance.model=list(model="sGARCH", garchOrder=c(1,0)), 
                          mean.model=list(armaOrder=c(p_order, q_order), include.mean=TRUE))
  fit.arch1 = ugarchfit(spec.arch1, data=ret)
  
  spec.garch11 = ugarchspec(variance.model=list(model="sGARCH", garchOrder=c(1,1)), 
                            mean.model=list(armaOrder=c(p_order, q_order), include.mean=TRUE))
  fit.garch11 = ugarchfit(spec.garch11, data=ret)
  
  spec.egarch11 = ugarchspec(variance.model=list(model="eGARCH", garchOrder=c(1,1)),  
                             mean.model=list(armaOrder=c(p_order, q_order), include.mean=TRUE),
                             distribution.model="norm")
  fit.egarch11 = ugarchfit(spec=spec.egarch11, data=ret, solver="hybrid")
  
  spec.tgarch11 = ugarchspec(variance.model=list(model="gjrGARCH", garchOrder=c(1,1)), 
                             mean.model=list(armaOrder=c(p_order, q_order), include.mean=TRUE),
                             distribution.model="norm")
  fit.tgarch11 = ugarchfit(spec.tgarch11, data=ret)
  
  # --- Perbandingan AIC ---
  cat("========== PERBANDINGAN AIC ==========\n")
  cat("ARCH(1)     : AIC =", infocriteria(fit.arch1)[1,1], "\n")
  cat("GARCH(1,1)  : AIC =", infocriteria(fit.garch11)[1,1], "\n")
  cat("EGARCH(1,1) : AIC =", infocriteria(fit.egarch11)[1,1], "\n")
  cat("TGARCH(1,1) : AIC =", infocriteria(fit.tgarch11)[1,1], "\n")
  
  # 5. VISUALISASI VOLATILITAS & FORECASTING (Untuk Model Terbaik)
  # Karena EGARCH(1,1) memiliki AIC terkecil pada RMKO, kita gunakan fit.egarch11
  
  # VISUAL 2: Plot Fitted Volatility
  kondisional_volatilitas = sigma(fit.egarch11)
  plot(kondisional_volatilitas, type="l", col="blue", 
       main="Fitted Volatility EGARCH(1,1) Saham RMKO", 
       ylab="Volatilitas (Standar Deviasi)", xlab="Waktu")
  
  # Melakukan Peramalan (Forecasting) 10 Hari ke Depan
  fcy_egarch = ugarchforecast(fit.egarch11, n.ahead=10)
  print(fcy_egarch)
  
  f_sigma = sigma(fcy_egarch)
  f_var = f_sigma^2
  print(f_var)
  
  # VISUAL 3: Plot Peramalan Volatilitas (Sigma Forecast)
  plot(fcy_egarch, which = 3) 
} else {
  
  fcy_arima = forecast(best_model, h=10)
  print(fcy_arima)
  plot(fcy_arima, main="Forecast Return (ARIMA Terbaik)", ylab="Return (%)")
}
```
